Name: Chaba's Portraits
Author: 0chabashira
Description:
[size=3]I don't speak English well, so sorry if there are any mistakes.[/size]

This mod changes portraits of some characters(Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, and Penny).

In order to use this mod together with vanilla portraits, I tried my best to imitate the touches and colors of the original portraits .
I made these portraits primarily for myself, but I decided to share because I thought someone else might like them.

To install, extract the zip file and put the .xnb files in "Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits" folder.
Please make sure to back-up your files before installation.

Thank you :)
